items.title: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Stock Trades Near Fair Value Following Its 41% Run
items.summary: Illinois Tool Works has delivered a solid run for shareholders in recent years, and the latest earnings update has pushed the debate back to a simple question: Is the current share price properly grounded in what the business is earning today and expected to earn over time? Over the past 5 years, the stock has returned about 40.8%, which raises the question of whether current earnings can support that kind of valuation. items.title: US large-cap dividend hike watch: 10 stocks with the longest growth streaks
items.summary: Investing.com -- This screen looks for US large caps (market cap above $10B) with a yield above 2%, a payout ratio below 60%, and dividend growth above 5%. They also need more than 5 straight years of increases. 47 stocks matched, and the table shows the 10 with the longest streaks. A low payout ratio means the company keeps room to raise the dividend again.

items.title: 4 Industrial Dividend Kings Whose Streaks Survived Every Recession

items.title: ITW Q3 deep dive: customer-driven innovation and end-market momentum shape outlook
items.summary: Manufacturing company Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as sales rose 4.4% year on year to $4.24 billion. Its GAAP profit of $3.00 per share was 0.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
